summary: Read a singly linked list and two positions counted from one, called the left end and the right end. The left end is never later than the right end. Reverse the nodes that lie inside that closed span, and keep every node outside the span in its original order and linkage. After the change, write each node value from the head toward the tail in the new order. The list contains at least one node, and both positions fall inside its length.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
